description: This file provides context management utilities for the 'clockwork' package, including functions to add clocks to contexts, extract clocks, and create contexts with fake clock deadlines for testing purposes. It defines a custom context implementation that uses a fake clock to simulate deadlines and cancellations.

classes.name: fakeClockContext
classes.description: A custom implementation of context.Context that uses a fake clock to manage deadlines and cancellations, primarily for testing purposes.

methods.name: AddToContext
methods.description: Creates a derived context that references the specified clock, injecting it into the context.

methods.name: FromContext
methods.description: Extracts a clock from the context, returning a real clock if none is set.

methods.name: WithDeadline
methods.description: Returns a context with a deadline based on a FakeClock, or delegates to the standard context.WithDeadline if not using a FakeClock.

methods.name: WithTimeout
methods.description: Returns a context with a timeout based on a FakeClock, or delegates to the standard context.WithTimeout if not using a FakeClock.
